crossRefs.note: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one…
Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they…
Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
His return was to Ramah, for his house was there; and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.
Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
Yahweh says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses…
“Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will…
Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted…
Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount…
They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them…
“Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity…

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
translations.bsb: They have crossed at the ford: “We will spend the night at Geba.” Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.
translations.kjv: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
translations.asv: they are gone over the pass; they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah trembleth; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
